others.route: Work Permit (Ministry of Labour and Social Security)

note: Jamaica: a non-Jamaican works on a work permit applied for to the Ministry of Labour and Social Security through the prospective employer, sponsor or contractor, under the Foreign Nationals and Commonwealth Citizens (Employment) Act, unless an exemption under its 1964 Exemptions Regulations applies; their categories weren't read, so no days are modelled. CARICOM artistes and musicians of the participating states work on the Skills Certificate (the csme list; the Ministry also administers the Caribbean Community Free Movement of Skilled Persons Act).

sources.title: Ministry of Labour and Social Security, Jamaica: Work Permit
sources.said: The Ministry’s Work Permit Unit is responsible for the administration of the Foreign Nationals and Commonwealth Citizens (Employment) Act and the Caribbean Community Free Movement of Skilled Persons Act. ... An individual seeking to obtain a Work Permit is required to make an application to this Ministry through his/her prospective employer, sponsor, contractor, or through legal representation.
